jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(1)(D) inventory: Maple Run Unified Union Supervisory District -- the Maple Run Unified School District is its own supervisory district (member towns: City of St. Albans, Town of St. Albans, Fairfield). Operating since July 1, 2017.
Maple Run Unified School District (official site).

sources.note: Maple Run USD: ten directors, residency allocated St. Albans City 4 / St. Albans Town 4 / Fairfield 2, elected at large by the whole district electorate (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) modified at-large; the district's warnings say so verbatim). The Articles of Agreement were not fetched verbatim -- the model rests on two consecutive official warnings plus the board page (three concordant official sources; a voter-formed district, no default-articles trap). Maple Run USD Warning for the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (official), Article I: "To elect, at large, by the legal voters of the Maple Run Unified School District, two (2) Directors from St. Albans Town for a three (3) year term. To elect, at large, by the legal voters of the Maple Run Unified School District, one (1) Director from St. Albans City for a three (3) year term." The March 4, 2025 warning is identical in form (Fairfield, Town, City).

Maple Run USD Board of Directors page (official): all ten members with "Represents" town and "Current Term Expires" -- City: Gonnella-French 2027, Brooks 2028, Gunderson 2027, Kenyon 2029; Town: Frost 2027, Palczewski 2028, McCarthy 2029, Williamson 2029; Fairfield: Jerose 2028, Dubie 2027. The expirations reconcile seat-for-seat with the 2025 and 2026 warnings.
